theorems.name: Submission.coarea_normDet_chain_rule
theorems.statement: ∀ (n N m : ℕ) (T : Submodule ℝ (Rn N)) (A : Rn n →ₗ[ℝ] Rn N) (L : T →ₗ[ℝ] Rn m) (Γ : Rn n →ₗ[ℝ] Rn m), Function.Injective A → LinearMap.range A = T → (∀ (v : Rn n) (hv : A v ∈ T), Γ v = L ⟨A v, hv⟩) → (LinearMap.adjoint L).normDet * A.normDet = (A ∘ₗ (LinearMap.ker Γ).subtype).normDet * (LinearMap.adjoint Γ).normDet
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
